reference_checks.check: Filling all required and optional fields with valid inputs (2 JPG/PNG photos under 10 MB, title 'Vintage Mechanical Keyboard', leaf category 'Electronics > Keyboards', condition 'Like new', price 150, valid description without phone numbers, Meetup with dropdown location, and Delivery with fee 10) enables the 'List it' button.
Clicking 'List it' with all valid required and optional fields filled creates and publishes the listing with all entered attributes.
Having 0 photos uploaded displays the error message for missing photos ('Add at least 1 photo').
Attempting to upload an unsupported photo file type (GIF or WEBP) displays 'Only JPG, PNG or HEIC files are supported'.
Attempting to upload an 11 MB JPG photo displays 'Each photo must be under 10 MB'.
Uploading 10 valid HEIC, PNG, or JPG photos after prior rejected uploads succeeds because rejected files do not count toward the 10-photo limit.
Attempting to upload an 11th valid photo when 10 valid photos are already uploaded displays 'You can add up to 10 photos'.
Entering '   abc   ' (3 characters after trimming whitespace) in Title and blurring displays 'Title must be 5–80 characters'.
Entering an 81-character string in Title and blurring displays 'Title must be 5–80 characters'.
Entering 'Gooooood phone' (6 consecutive 'o's) in Title and blurring displays 'Title can't repeat the same character more than 3 times in a row'.
Entering 'Goood phone' (3 consecutive 'o's) in Title and blurring passes validation.
Selecting a parent category that has subcategories and blurring displays 'Choose a more specific category'.
Selecting a valid leaf category clears the category validation error.
Switching from one valid leaf category to a different valid leaf category preserves previously entered Title, Price, Photos, and other fields.
Entering 0 in Price is accepted and displays as 'Free' when previewed or published.
Entering -1 in Price displays 'Enter a price between 0 and 9,999,999'.
Entering a decimal value (10.99) in Price displays 'Enter a price between 0 and 9,999,999'.
Entering 10000000 in Price displays 'Enter a price between 0 and 9,999,999'.
Entering 'Model 1234567' (7 digits) in Description is allowed without error.
Entering 'Call me at 9123 4567' (8 digits separated by a space) in Description displays 'For your safety, don't include phone numbers in the description'.
Entering '9123-4567' (8 digits separated by a dash) in Description displays 'For your safety, don't include phone numbers in the description'.
Entering 4,001 characters in Description displays 'Description can be up to 4,000 characters'.
Leaving both Meetup and Delivery unchecked displays 'Choose at least one deal method'.
Checking Meetup and typing free text without selecting from search results displays 'Pick a meetup location from the list'.
Selecting a valid Meetup location and then unchecking Meetup clears and hides the Meetup location field (remaining cleared when Meetup is re-checked).
Checking Delivery and entering 501 displays 'Delivery fee must be between 0 and 500'.
Entering a valid Delivery fee (50) and then unchecking Delivery clears and hides the Delivery fee field.

Sending a direct POST request to the Create Listing API bypassing UI checks with a 4-character title is rejected by the server with the exact error message from the spec ('Title must be 5–80 characters').

Sending a direct POST request to the Create Listing API bypassing UI checks with a phone number in the description is rejected by the server with the exact error message from the spec ('For your safety, don't include phone numbers in the description').

Sending a direct POST request to the Create Listing API bypassing UI checks with a non-leaf category is rejected by the server with the exact error message from the spec ('Choose a more specific category').

Sending a direct POST request to the Create Listing API bypassing UI checks with a delivery fee of 600 is rejected by the server with the exact error message from the spec ('Delivery fee must be between 0 and 500').

checklist_items.item: Photos format: an unsupported file type (e.g., GIF) rejected.
Photos size boundary: exactly 10 MB accepted.
Photos size boundary: just over 10 MB rejected.
A photo rejected for size or type does not count toward the 10-photo limit.
Title whitespace trimming: a whitespace-padded string whose trimmed length is below 5 characters fails validation.
Title consecutive characters boundary: 3 consecutive identical characters accepted.
Title consecutive characters boundary: 4 consecutive identical characters rejected.
Price boundary: 0 accepted and displays as 'Free'.
Description phone-number boundary: 8 consecutive digits rejected.
Description phone-number detection: 8+ digits with spaces or dashes rejected.
Deal method: both Meetup and Delivery accepted.
Conditional field: Meetup location free text (not selected from search results) rejected.
Unchecking Meetup clears and hides the Meetup location field.
Unchecking Delivery clears and hides the Delivery fee field.
Server-side validation: invalid submissions bypassing the client are rejected via the API with the same validation error messages.
'List it' button remains disabled until all required fields pass client-side validation.
On submit failure, the page scrolls to the first invalid field in top-to-bottom table order.
Changing the category keeps values entered in other fields.
